pictures.scene: Cefalu Cathedral, Christ Pantocrator — Christ filling the gold half-dome from the waist up, His right hand lifted in blessing and the Greek gospel held open in His left, a blue mantle over a gold tunic and the jewelled cross set in the halo behind His long hair, and below Him in the next band the Virgin standing with both hands raised between two archangels in jewelled court robes with their great wings folded down, this is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants
pictures.name: pd_master_of_cefalu_christ_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Bol, The Angel Appearing to Elijah — the angel standing over the sleeping prophet in a long white robe with gold braid and heavy green tassels, a dark glass flask carried down in one hand and the other stretched out toward him, and Elijah thrown back on the ground in a red cloak and an olive mantle with his head propped on his arm and his eyes shut, the tree and the night standing behind them, what must soon come to pass, He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John
pictures.name: pd_bol_the_angel_appearing_to_elijah

pictures.scene: Master of the Female Half-Lengths, Saint John on Patmos — John sitting out on the grass of the island in a red gown with a pink mantle fallen round him, barefoot, the quill lifted in one hand and the little book open on his knee, his face turned up toward the glory of light far off in the sky, the black eagle standing at his shoulder with the inkhorn hanging from its beak, a small dragon flying over the water and the sea running out past rocks and a walled town to the hills, who testifies to everything he saw, this is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ
pictures.name: pd_master_of_the_female_half_lengths_saint_john_on_patmos

pictures.scene: Gerrit Dou, Old Woman Reading a Lectionary — the old woman seen in profile in a fur cap and a heavy dark coat with a wide fur collar and a gold clasp at her throat, both worn hands holding the great printed book up close to her face, and her eyes down on the open page where the word Evangelium stands over a little woodcut, blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it
pictures.name: pd_dou_old_woman_reading_a_lectionary

pictures.scene: Johannes Bosboom, Church Interior — the whitewashed Gothic piers going up into the arches with the light lying along them, a carved stone tablet and a gilt memorial fixed to the columns, the dark wooden pew and its turned rail at the left, a plain bench standing out on the worn stone floor, and down at the foot of the pillar a woman sitting with a child beside her holding a basket, nobody else in the whole church, because the time is near, John to the seven churches in the province of Asia
pictures.name: pd_bosboom_kerk

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, God Enthroned — the enthroned figure seen close and straight on, a triple tiara of pearls and sapphires and red stones on His head, long dark hair falling over both shoulders and a deep red mantle clasped at the breast with a great round jewel of pearls and blue stones, the pearl-sewn orphrey bands with their crosses hanging down either side of Him, and behind His head the gold rays going out into the ringed arch lettered in Latin, grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven spirits before His throne
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned

pictures.scene: Matthias Grunewald, The Resurrection — Christ going up out of the open stone tomb into the night with both pierced hands lifted wide, His face and hair burning white in the middle of a great disc of light that goes from gold to red to blue against the stars, the yellow and red and white robe streaming off Him and the long shroud still trailing down into the empty grave, and the armed guards in helmets and mail thrown flat on the ground below with their swords and halberds fallen among the rocks, and from Jesus Christ the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_resurrection

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Coronation of the Virgin — Christ sitting crowned on the high gold throne in a rose robe and a great blue mantle, reaching forward with both hands to set the gold crown on the head of His mother, who kneels before Him on the step with her hands folded and a blue cloak lined with white falling away behind her, ranks of haloed angels in rose and blue crowding in on either side with trumpets and lutes and little organs, and the saints and a bishop in a mitre kneeling on the checkered floor below, one holding up a gold vessel, and the ruler of the kings of the earth, to Him who loves us
pictures.name: pd_angelico_coronation

pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbaran, The Crucifixion — Christ alone on the rough wooden cross out of a black ground, the one light falling along His arms and across His body, the white linen knotted at His waist and the long end of it hanging down past His knee, the crown of thorns on His head and His face turned down onto His shoulder with the eyes shut, the nails through both hands and through the crossed feet set on the little wooden block, the written tablet above Him and nothing else anywhere in the picture, and has released us from our sins by His blood, who has made us to be a kingdom
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_crucifixion

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Glory — Christ sitting inside a deep blue oval ring set all round with little winged heads, in a pale blue robe with a crossed gold halo behind Him, one hand raised and the other held open, gold rays going out from the ring across the whole gold ground, an angel standing below with the tall cross held upright in both hands, and the Virgin and the saints and the crowned ranks of heaven kneeling and standing close on either side with their palms pressed together, priests to His God and Father, to Him be the glory and power forever and ever, Amen
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

pictures.scene: John Singleton Copley, The Ascension — Christ carried up off the ground in a white robe with both arms opened wide and His face lifted into the gold light breaking through the clouds, the banked grey and gold cloud rolling away on either side of Him, the hills and the little white house small and quiet far below, and the whole company of disciples down on the dark ground reaching their hands up after Him, some standing with their heads thrown back, some fallen on their knees, one shielding his eyes, behold He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him
pictures.name: pd_copley_ascension

pictures.scene: Giotto, The Lamentation — the dead body of Christ laid along the bare ground with the white cloth drawn over Him, His mother holding His head up against her face and another woman lifting His pierced hand to look at it, the women and the disciples pressed in all round Him on the rock with their heads bent and their faces working, one standing with both arms flung back, and the whole blue sky above crowded with small angels tumbling and crying out with their hands at their faces, even those who pierced Him, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him
pictures.name: pd_giotto_lamentation

pictures.scene: Daphni Monastery, Christ Pantocrator — the great mosaic face filling the whole picture, worked out of little stones in grey and gold, the dark hair falling either side and the heavy dark beard, the brows drawn together and the wide eyes looking straight out and down at whoever is standing underneath, the cross set into the gold ring behind His head, a blue-green mantle over the shoulder, and the jewelled gold book held up against His arm with His hand lying open below it, so shall it be, Amen, I am the Alpha and the Omega says the Lord God
pictures.name: pd_daphni_christ_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, Chaos, The Creation of the World — the whole sky taken up with vast brown storm cloud rolling over a dark sea, one break of white light high up at the top with the faint shape of a figure standing in it with arms spread, the light coming down through the torn cloud and laying a long bright track across the broken water, the waves running up white out of the dark, and nothing standing anywhere on the sea, who is and was and is to come the Almighty, I John your brother and partner
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_chaos_the_creation_of_the_world

pictures.scene: Nicolas Poussin, Landscape with Saint John on Patmos — John sitting right down on the bare ground at the bottom of the picture in a red robe and a yellow cloak, barefoot, leaning on one elbow with the book open on his knee and the pen in his hand, loose sheets lying beside him and the eagle standing at his shoulder, a drum of a fallen column by his feet, and above and behind him the whole island opening out, broken temples and an obelisk and a ruined arch among the trees with the water and the blue hills beyond, in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos
pictures.name: pd_poussin_landscape_with_saint_john_on_patmos

pictures.scene: El Greco, Saint Francis in Prayer — the friar kneeling alone in the mouth of a dark cave in a grey patched habit with the knotted cord hanging down from his waist to the ground, the hood pushed back off his head, his thin face lifted and turned a little aside with his mouth open as if he were answering someone, one hand laid flat on his breast with the wound showing in it, a few ivy leaves coming over the rock at the top of the picture and the black of the cave behind him, because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus, on the Lord's day I was in the Spirit
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_st_francis_in_prayer

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, The Seven Angels with the Trumpets — the whole woodcut packed with line, the ancient Father seated up in the rays at the top of the picture with the angels crowding round Him, an angel at the altar swinging the censer and the smoke going up, and the seven angels standing out on the clouds in long robes with the long trumpets lifted to their mouths, one after another, the blasts coming down out of heaven onto the sea and the hills below where the ships are driven over and the little town stands on the shore, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet, saying write on a scroll what you see
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_seven_angels_with_the_trumpets

pictures.scene: Gerrit Berckheyde, The Church of Saint Bavo — the long whitewashed nave running away from us under the ribbed vaults, bay after bay of pointed arches with the daylight coming down the aisle, a brass chandelier hanging on its chain in the middle of it and the carved wooden pulpit standing up at the right, two men in black cloaks and broad hats talking at the front, a little group kneeling on the stone floor at the slab of a grave with the children leaning in to look, and a few more people far off down the aisle, and send it to the seven churches, to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira
pictures.name: pd_berckheyde_bavokerk

pictures.scene: Hubert Robert, A Hermit Praying in the Ruins of a Roman Temple — the hermit kneeling in a long white habit with his hood up and his back to us, in front of a block of stone with the open book and a skull and a little crucifix set on it, the great ruined colonnade of the temple going away behind him with a rough roof thrown over it and the daylight falling through, weeds and creepers hanging down the broken wall, a ladder set against the stones with a woman leaning over the top of it, and two countrywomen standing in the doorway at the right watching him pray, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea, then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me
pictures.name: pd_robert_a_hermit_praying_in_the_ruins_of_a_roman_temple

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, The Vision of the Seven Candlesticks — the Son of Man sitting up in the clouds in a long loose robe with the rays going out all round His head, the hair and the long beard curling down over His shoulders, one arm stretched out wide with the seven stars burning in His open hand, the sword coming out of His mouth and lying across the air, the open book held against His knees, the tall branched candlesticks standing round Him with their candles lit, and John thrown down on his face at the bottom of the picture in a heavy robe with his bare feet behind him, and having turned I saw seven golden lampstands, and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_vision_of_the_seven_candlesticks

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Christ Blessing — the face filling nearly the whole picture, the long brown hair parted and falling down over both shoulders and a thin beard along the jaw, the eyes looking straight out at whoever is in front of it, a deep red robe on His shoulders, the gold halo worked with fine rays behind His head and a ring of dark blue cloud round the edge of it, and His right hand raised close under His chin with two fingers lifted, dressed in a long robe with a golden sash around His chest, the hair of His head was white like wool as white as snow
pictures.name: pd_memling_christ_blessing

pictures.scene: Joseph Wright of Derby, An Iron Forge — the white hot bar of iron lying on the anvil under the great tilt hammer and throwing the only light there is right up into the roof beams of the forge, the smith bent over the work with his back to us and his shirt open, the young man standing against the brick wall with his arms folded and his head wrapped in a cloth, watching, and the women and the little child in the warm edge of the light at the right looking on, and His eyes were like a blazing fire, His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace
pictures.name: pd_wright_an_iron_forge

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, Waterfall in a Rocky Landscape — the whole bottom of the picture taken up with white water pouring down over the ledges and breaking round the big rocks, the spray going up off it, a wooden footbridge thrown across the river above the fall with two small figures crossing it, a rocky bluff behind with firs and a house standing up among the trees, and the great heap of cloud piled over it all with one break of blue, and His voice was like the roar of many waters, He held in His right hand seven stars
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_waterfall_in_a_rocky_landscape

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Sunrise — the whole valley filled with gold haze at first light, the sun itself burning white behind the branches of a great leaning oak at the right, the cliffs standing up grey and sheer on the left with the mist lying along their feet, the still river below holding the gold light on its surface, scattered trees and low scrub along the bank, and not a person anywhere in it, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth, His face was like the sun shining at its brightest
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_sunrise

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Conversion of Saul — Saul flat on his back on the ground at the bottom of the picture in a red cloak and a breastplate with his helmet rolled off beside him, his eyes shut and both arms thrown straight up into the air as if to take hold of something he cannot see, his sword lying where it fell, the great piebald horse standing right over him and lifting one hoof clear of his body, and the old groom in a brown tunic bent over the bridle at the side holding the animal back, when I saw Him I fell at His feet like a dead man, but He placed His right hand on me and said
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_conversion_of_saul

pictures.scene: Alexander Ivanov, The Risen Christ — Christ standing out of the dark garden in the grave sheet wound round Him and gathered up in one hand, barefoot on the bare ground with the leaves and the low wall behind Him, His long hair fallen either side of His face and the mark of the spear still under His breast, looking quietly aside and stretching His right arm out full length toward a pair of hands lifted to Him at the edge of the picture, do not be afraid, I am the First and the Last, the Living One
pictures.name: pd_ivanov_risen_christ

pictures.scene: Carl Bloch, The Resurrection — Christ risen upright in the mouth of the rock tomb in a white grave cloth that falls to His bare feet, a gold ring of light round His head and His face turned up, both arms thrown wide and open above Him, the broken slab and the grave stone tipped over on the ground in front of Him with white lilies growing up beside it, and an angel kneeling on either side in a long white robe with hands pressed together looking up at Him, I was dead and behold now I am alive forever and ever, and I hold the keys of Death and of Hades
pictures.name: pd_bloch_resurrection

pictures.scene: Diego Velazquez, Saint John the Evangelist on Patmos — the young apostle sitting out on the rock in a loose grey-white tunic with a rose mantle falling over his knees, barefoot, the thin gold line of a halo behind his dark head, the great open book held steady on his lap with one hand and the quill lifted in the other while he stops and looks away up into the air, the eagle standing in the dark at his side, and far off in a break of cloud the small lit vision of the woman and the dragon he is being given to write, therefore write down the things you have seen, the things that are and the things that will happen after this
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_saint_john_the_evangelist_on_patmos

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, The Starry Night — the night sky taking up almost the whole picture in heavy blue brushstrokes with the great white spiral turning through the middle of it, the stars burning yellow and each one set in its own ring of light, the moon low and blazing at the left, the dark flame of the cypress going up the near edge from bottom to top, and down in the corner the little town lying asleep under the hills with its windows lit and the church spire standing up among the roofs, this is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand, and of the seven golden lampstands
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_the_starry_night

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Singing Angels — Christ standing on the cloud against a gold ground in a deep blue cope clasped with a great jewelled morse, a crowned tiara on His head and the gold rays struck out all round it, one hand raised in blessing and the crystal orb of the world held at His side, and beside Him two angels in green and gold copes with crowns on their fair heads and coloured wings behind them, singing out of the one book they hold open between them, the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches
pictures.name: pd_memling_singing_angels

lines.text: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ,
which God gave Him to show His servants
what must soon come to pass.
He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
who testifies to everything he saw.
This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy,
and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it,
because the time is near.
John, to the seven churches in the province of Asia:
Grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come,
and from the seven spirits before His throne,
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness,
the firstborn from the dead,
and the ruler of the kings of the earth.
To Him who loves us
and has released us from our sins by His blood,
who has made us to be a kingdom,
priests to His God and Father,
to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
Behold, He is coming with the clouds,
and every eye will see Him,
even those who pierced Him.
And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him.
So shall it be! Amen.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God,
who is and was and is to come, the Almighty.
I, John, your brother and partner
in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus,
was on the island of Patmos
because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.
On the Lord's day I was in the Spirit,
and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
saying, Write on a scroll what you see
and send it to the seven churches:
to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira,
Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.
Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me.
And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man,
dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest.
The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow,
and His eyes were like a blazing fire.
His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace,
and His voice was like the roar of many waters.
He held in His right hand seven stars,
and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth.
His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man.
But He placed His right hand on me and said,
Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
the Living One.
I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever!
And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
Therefore write down the things you have seen,
the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand
and of the seven golden lampstands:
The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches,
and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
